newsitem.title: USA: Gehl, New Holland in manufacturing pact.
newsitem.headline: Gehl, New Holland in manufacturing pact.

text.p: Gehl Co said Monday it signed agreements with New Holland North America Inc, a unit of Fiat SpA, involving the production of waste handling equipment.

Gehl said it will make New Holland-brand V-tank manure spreaders that will be sold through the New Holland dealer network. Meanwhile, New Holland will manufacture Gehl-branded box-type manure speaders to be sold through the Gehl dealer network. Financial terms were not announced.
The companies said the pacts will improve production efficiencies at plants in Belleville and Lebanon, Pennsylvania.
Gehl makes equipment for construction and agricultural markets.
